---
title: "Robustness Check: Preregistered Models"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

The primary analyses use a cubic term for `depression_sum`, chosen in `Main Analysis.Rmd` section 1.5. This check refits the primary models as preregistered, with a linear term, and compares predictions and risk ratios.

```{r setup, message = F, warning = F}
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(mice)
library(marginaleffects)
library(tidyverse)
`%+%` <- paste0

source(here("Helper Functions", "Analysis Functions.R"))

pimh_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH - 2012-2019", "pimh_completed.rds"))
pih_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIH - 2019-Current", "pih_completed.rds"))
all_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH + PIH Combined", "all_completed.rds"))
```

```{r fit}
covariates <- " + decimal_year_centered + age + race_recoded + gender + education"

specifications <- tribble(
  ~dataset,   ~data,  ~years,       ~extra,
  "PIMH",     pimh_c, c(2016, 2019), "",
  "PIH",      pih_c,  c(2019, 2026), "",
  "Combined", all_c,  c(2016, 2026), " + dataset"
)

# Fit preregistered (linear) and primary (cubic) models; keep only predictions and risk ratios
results <- specifications %>%
  expand_grid(model = c("Preregistered (linear)", "Primary (cubic)")) %>%
  mutate(
    formula = if_else(model == "Primary (cubic)", "poly(depression_sum, 3)", "depression_sum"),
    formula = "dep_self_label_now ~ " %+% formula %+% covariates %+% extra,
    fit = map2(data, formula, ~ fit_models(.x, as.formula(.y))),
    predictions = map2(fit, years, ~ as_tibble(point_predictions(.x, .y))),
    ratios = map(fit, ~ as_tibble(risk_ratios(.x)))
  )
```

## Coefficients, Preregistered Models (Log-Odds)

```{r coefficients}
preregistered <- results %>%
  filter(model == "Preregistered (linear)") %>%
  pull(fit, name = dataset)

summarize_models(preregistered$PIMH, exp = F)
summarize_models(preregistered$PIH, exp = F)
summarize_models(preregistered$Combined, exp = F)
```

## Risk Ratios per Year

```{r ratios}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, ratios) %>%
  unnest(ratios) %>%
  select(dataset, model, depression_sum, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Point Predictions

```{r predictions}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, predictions) %>%
  unnest(predictions) %>%
  transmute(dataset, model, depression_sum, year = decimal_year_centered + 2021, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```
